title: Staff Engineer-UI
description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for a Staff Engineer who can build new features in Angular 21while also rolling up your sleeves on older code-refactoring legacy components, state management, and API integrations into patterns that actually scale.
  
  
This is a full-time position based out of Kochi.
  
  
***Preferred Location***
Qualified candidates should be based in or near Kochi and able to work from our Kochi office as part of a hybrid schedule.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Build features in Angular 21 using Signals, standalone components, and zoneless change detection
* Dig into older code, understand it, and refactor it into something maintainable
* Contribute to our Angular Material -> Zard UI migration
* Build reactive data flows with NgRx and RxJS
* Build components that look and work great on both mobile and desktop using TailwindCSS and Sass

***Education Requirement***
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Master of Computer Applications.
  
  
***Role and Responsibilities***

* Play a pivotal role in the team, working closely with Product & UX teams, to single handedly own individual modules that are part of an enterprise suite of applications
* Lead the design and solution for refactoring complex legacy codebases
* Play an important role in optimization across solution/architecture/code
* Lead technical conversations with non-engineering stakeholders
* Influence a positive team culture: raising the bar on quality, documentation, and shared ownership
* Define and optimize CI/CD pipelines and automation
* Design, development of scalable enterprise grade applications
* Scoping and breaking down large initiatives into iterative, shippable pieces
* Review code, share knowledge, and help shape how we build things going forward
* Strongly desirable - Having exposure to AI tools to develop UI screens & troubleshoot production issues

**Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills**

* 7-10 years in frontend/UI engineering
* Strong Angular 21 skills for: Signals, Signal Forms, standalone components, zoneless change detection
* NgRx and RxJS
* TailwindCSS and Sass, with a strong grasp of responsive design for mobile and desktop
* Play a pivotal role in the team, working closely with Product & UX teams, to build products that are designed to meet the demands of scale
* Comfortable reading and refactoring complex legacy codebases
* Rich experience in optimization across solution/architecture/code
* Strongly desirable - Having exposure to AI tools to develop UI screens & troubleshoot production issues

**About Dodge Construction Network**
Dodge Construction Network exists to deliver the comprehensive data and connections the construction industry needs to build thriving communities. Our legacy is deeply rooted in empowering our customers with transformative insights, igniting their journey towards unparalleled business expansion and success. We serve decision-makers who seek reliable growth and who value relationships built on trust and quality. By combining our proprietary data with cutting-edge software, we deliver to our customers the essential intelligence needed to excel within their respective landscapes. We propel the construction industry forward by transforming data into tangible guidance, driving unparalleled advancement.
  
  
Dodge is the catalyst for modern construction.

title: Senior MES Delivery Lead
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior MES Delivery Lead will work closely with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Automation, IT, Data Backbone teams, and external technology partners to drive MES adoption and support manufacturing transformation initiatives. Responsibilities include process analysis, requirements engineering, workshop facilitation, solution evaluation, architecture collaboration, implementation support, deployment planning, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement activities.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as a subject matter expert for MES and digital manufacturing systems, helping to define future-state manufacturing processes, support Smart Factory initiatives, and contribute to the long-term development of SPS's manufacturing technology landscape. As the program evolves, the role is expected to progress toward ownership of MES strategy, deployment activities, and future capability development within the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead and support MES implementation, deployment, and scaling activities across SPS manufacturing sites globally.
* Analyse manufacturing processes and identify opportunities for digitalisation, automation, process optimisation, and operational improvements.
* Gather, define, structure, and maintain business, functional, technical, and architectural requirements for MES and related manufacturing systems.
* Develop and maintain manufacturing use cases, business scenarios, process flows, and solution evaluation criteria.
* Facilitate workshops with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Planning, Automation, IT, and business stakeholders to capture requirements and align solution designs.
* Evaluate MES modules and capabilities against business needs, technology architecture, integration requirements, scalability, and long-term sustainability objectives.
* Contribute to solution architecture design involving MES, ERP, PLM, SCADA, PLC, Historian, APS, and related manufacturing systems.
* Support integration planning and coordination between enterprise platforms and manufacturing systems to ensure effective information flow across the manufacturing environment.
* Participate in system testing, validation activities, deployment planning, issue resolution, and implementation support throughout project lifecycles.
* Collaborate closely with Smart Factory, Data Backbone, Automation, Quality, Engineering, Operations, IT teams, and external technology vendors.
* Prepare documentation including requirements specifications, process maps, evaluation reports, implementation plans, testing documentation, and deployment materials.
* Support decision-making processes through technical analysis, solution recommendations, and business case development.
* Promote best practices in digital manufacturing, Industry 4.0, Smart Factory solutions, and manufacturing system governance.
* Take ownership of assigned initiatives and drive activities through completion while effectively communicating progress, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Contribute to the development of future MES capabilities and support the growth of SPS's digital manufacturing competency.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Systems, Industrial Automation, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), manufacturing systems, industrial digitalisation, Smart Factory initiatives, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading or supporting end-to-end MES implementation, deployment, and rollout projects within manufacturing environments.
* Strong understanding of MES integration with ERP, PLC, SCADA, Historian, APS, PLM, Quality Management Systems, and related manufacturing technologies.
* Experience conducting manufacturing process mapping, business analysis, requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, and solution evaluation activities.
* Good understanding of enterprise architecture and manufacturing system architecture principles.
* Ability to work effectively across Operations, Engineering, Quality, IT, and business stakeholder groups.
* Experience working within manufacturing environments and a strong understanding of shopfloor operations and production processes.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
* Experience with MES platforms such as AVEVA, Critical Manufacturing, Siemens Opcenter, Rockwell FactoryTalk, Proficy, or similar solutions is preferred.
* Experience supporting global or multi-site manufacturing deployments is highly desirable.
* Exposure to Industry 4.0, Industrial Data Backbone, Unified Namespace (UNS), MQTT, Industrial Historian platforms, or related technologies is advantageous.
* Experience within engineer-to-order, project-based, high-mix, batch, continuous, or other complex manufacturing environments is preferred.
* Demonstrates ownership, leadership, and a proactive approach to driving initiatives, managing stakeholders, and delivering business outcomes.
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in international and cross-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel internationally, including visits to Denmark, Brazil, the UK, and other SPS manufacturing locations as required.

**About Us**
Every day, the oil and gas industry’s best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.
  
  
**We Power the Industry that Powers the World**
Throughout every region in the world and across every area of drilling and production, our family of companies has provided the technical expertise, advanced equipment, and operational support necessary for success—now and in the future.
  
  
**Global Family**
We are a global family of thousands of individuals, working as one team to create a lasting impact for ourselves, our customers, and the communities where we live and work.
  
  
**Purposeful Innovation**
Through purposeful business innovation, product creation, and service delivery, we are driven to power the industry that powers the world better.
  
  
**Service Above All**
This drives us to anticipate our customers’ needs and work with them to deliver the finest products and services on time and on budget.

title: Software Verification & Testing Lead
description:
We are seeking an experienced Software Verification & Testing Lead to lead software verification, validation, and quality assurance activities for medical device and connected healthcare applications.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong experience in software testing methodologies, test automation, requirement traceability, defect management, and regulatory compliance. The role involves ensuring the reliability, safety, security, and performance of embedded software, mobile applications, cloud platforms, and integrated medical device systems.
  
  
‍
  
  
**Key Competencies**

* Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
* Hands-on experience in manual and automated software testing.
* Experience with test automation tools such as Selenium, Appium, Playwright, or equivalent frameworks.
* Proficiency in Python or another scripting language for test automation.
* Strong experience in API testing using Postman, REST Assured, or similar tools.
* Experience in integration testing, system testing, regression testing, and defect management.
* Familiarity with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or TestRail.
* Knowledge of Linux environments, networking fundamentals, and database testing.
* Experience preparing test plans, test cases, test execution reports, and requirement traceability matrices.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and team management skills.

‍
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Software Verification & Validation
  
  

* Lead end-to-end software verification and validation activities across the software development lifecycle.
* Develop and execute test strategies, test plans, test cases, and verification protocols based on software requirements.
* Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and performance testing.
* Ensure complete requirement-to-test traceability and maintain verification documentation.
* Review software requirements and design specifications to ensure testability and compliance.
* Identify, document, track, and resolve software defects in collaboration with development teams.

Test Automation & Technical Testing
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks to improve test coverage and efficiency.
* Perform API testing, database validation, and end-to-end application testing.
* Validate data communication and integration between wearable devices, mobile applications, backend services, and cloud platforms.
* Test real-time data acquisition, transmission, processing, and visualization.
* Perform reliability testing, including connectivity interruptions, data loss, recovery, and error-handling scenarios.
* Integrate automated tests with CI/CD pipelines where applicable.

Medical Device Quality & Compliance
  
  

* Support software verification and validation activities in accordance with applicable medical device standards.
* Maintain verification evidence, test reports, defect records, and traceability matrices.
* Participate in risk-based testing and verification of safety-critical software functions.
* Support design reviews, quality audits, and regulatory documentation.
* Collaborate with quality assurance and regulatory teams to ensure compliance with applicable requirements.

Team Leadership & Coordination
  
  

* Lead and mentor software verification and testing engineers.
* Assign testing activities, monitor progress, and ensure timely completion of verification milestones.
* Coordinate with software developers, embedded engineers, system architects, and product teams.
* Review test deliverables and communicate testing status, risks, and quality metrics to stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvements in testing processes, automation, and software quality.

‍

title: Software Diagnostics & Performance Test Engineer
description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.
  
  
*SOTI does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. You can verify the authenticity of any SOTI job opportunities by visiting SOTI Careers. SOTI shall not be liable for any fraudulent recruitment activities carried out by unauthorized individuals or organizations.*
**What You Will Do**

* Investigate complex and ambiguous software failures and performance problems.
* Perform deep root-cause analysis across application, system, network, database, and infrastructure layers.
* Analyze application logs, system logs, stack traces, thread dumps, heap dumps, metrics, traces, and profiling data.
* Analyze network traffic and protocols to identify latency, connectivity, retransmission, timeout, and communication issues.
* Investigate issues that occur only under specific workloads, concurrency levels, configurations, environments, or long-running conditions.
* Understand product architecture and critical customer workflows deeply enough to reason about failure modes.
* Learn the product in depth, including core workflows, customer usage patterns, deployment models, and performance-sensitive areas.
* Design experiments to isolate variables and prove or disprove hypotheses.
* Develop diagnostic scripts, instrumentation, and small tools when necessary to accelerate investigations.
* Perform exploratory testing and deliberately challenge system assumptions to discover weaknesses and failure modes.
* Investigate performance degradation, scalability limitations, resource exhaustion, latency spikes, and throughput bottlenecks.
* Create meaningful Performance Test Cases based on product architecture, customer workflows, expected load patterns, scalability goals, and known risk areas.
* Review Performance Test Cases created by other engineers to ensure coverage, clarity, workload relevance, data validity, and alignment with product behavior.
* Execute Performance Test Cases, analyze results, identify bottlenecks or regressions, and communicate findings with clear evidence and recommended actions.
* Correlate evidence across multiple components of distributed systems.
* Work with developers to identify the actual root cause rather than simply identifying the component where the symptom appeared.
* Clearly communicate technical findings, evidence, root cause, impact, and recommended corrective actions.
* Build and maintain diagnostic knowledge, troubleshooting methodologies, and internal technical documentation.
* Mentor other engineers in systematic debugging and root-cause analysis.

**Must-have Qualifications**

* Technical
* 5+ years of software engineering, performance engineering, systems engineering, reliability engineering, production troubleshooting, or a closely related discipline, preferably in a product-based software company.
* Programming/debugging ability in at least one major language such as Java, C++, C#, Python, etc.
* Strong ability to read and understand unfamiliar application code.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex software problems.
* Strong understanding of operating-system concepts: processes, threads, memory, CPU, file I/O, sockets, synchronization, resource utilization
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, connection management, latency, timeouts, retransmissions
* Experience analyzing logs and traces across multiple components.
* Experience with application profiling and/or performance analysis.
* Hands-on experience creating, reviewing, and executing Performance Test Cases for complex software products.
* Experience diagnosing concurrency, latency, resource contention, or scalability issues.
* Ability to interpret performance test results, compare them with baselines, identify regressions, and connect findings back to product behavior or code-level causes.
* Ability to formulate hypotheses and systematically validate them with evidence.
* Behavioral
* Exceptional curiosity about how software systems work.
* Strong interest in learning the product deeply rather than treating testing as a black-box activity.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable working with incomplete or ambiguous information.
* Willingness to challenge assumptions.
* Persistence when the first explanation isn't the real root cause.
* Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly.
* Comfortable collaborating with developers without simply handing problems back to them.
* Strong ownership of difficult investigations

If you want to bring your ideas to life, apply at SOTI today.

title: Senior Manager R&D (HoD)
description:

**Senior Manager (HoD)**
**Location:**
Kochi, Kerala, India
  
  
**Department:**
Research & Development
  
  
**Industry:**
Robotics, Underwater Systems & Deep-Tech Engineering
  
  
**Experience:**
10+ Years
  
  
**Role Type:**
Senior Leadership
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced
**Sr Manager of R&D**
to lead the end-to-end technology and product development function for a deep-tech engineering organization specializing in underwater robotics and integrated hardware-software systems.
  
  
The role will be responsible for translating business and customer requirements into reliable, scalable, and production-ready products. The ideal candidate will bring strong systems-engineering expertise, product development experience, and proven leadership capabilities to build a high-performing R&D organization.
  
  
The position requires a combination of technical judgment, strategic thinking, execution discipline, and cross-functional leadership to drive product innovation and business growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* R&D Strategy & Technology Roadmap
* Define and execute a 2–3-year R&D and technology roadmap aligned with business objectives and customer requirements.
* Identify emerging technologies, innovation opportunities, and platform development priorities.
* Establish technology-readiness milestones and product development priorities.
* Product Development & Engineering Delivery
* Lead the complete product development lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through prototyping, integration, validation, field trials, and production handover.
* Ensure engineering programs meet agreed timelines, budgets, quality standards, and performance objectives.
* Drive structured program governance, milestone tracking, risk management, and corrective actions.
* Systems Engineering & Technical Excellence
* Oversee multidisciplinary engineering across mechanical systems, electronics, embedded systems, software, controls, sensors, communications, and system integration.
* Establish strong engineering practices covering requirements management, design reviews, configuration control, and verification and validation.
* Drive structured problem-solving, reliability engineering, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
* Testing, Validation & Product Reliability
* Establish validation strategies covering laboratory testing, environmental testing, integration, endurance, and field trials.
* Ensure products meet defined reliability, performance, safety, and acceptance criteria before release.
* Monitor field failures and recurring defects and drive corrective and preventive actions.
* Production Readiness & Industrialization
* Ensure smooth transition of products from R&D to manufacturing and operations.
* Establish complete handover processes covering engineering drawings, bills of materials (BOMs), specifications, firmware, software versions, test procedures, and acceptance criteria.
* Improve design-for-manufacturing, assembly, serviceability, and production readiness.
* Customer & Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work closely with business leadership, Sales, Operations, Production, and project teams to evaluate technical feasibility and customer requirements.
* Support technical discussions, solution estimation, field trials, and customer escalations.
* Ensure delivery commitments are realistic, risks are identified early, and dependencies are resolved effectively.
* Team Leadership & Organization Development
* Lead and develop multidisciplinary R&D teams and engineering leaders.
* Establish clear responsibilities, accountability, performance expectations, and succession plans.
* Identify capability gaps and develop hiring and team-strengthening strategies.
* Build a culture of technical excellence, transparency, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Budget, Partnerships & Risk Management
* Own R&D budgeting, resource planning, laboratory infrastructure, prototyping, tools, and external development requirements.
* Evaluate technology vendors, development partners, and make-versus-buy decisions.
* Protect intellectual property, technical documentation, source code, and confidential engineering knowledge.
* Manage technical, supply-chain, component obsolescence, compliance, and program risks.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
**Performance Will Be Measured Against The Following Areas**

* Program Delivery: Milestone adherence, schedule variance, and delivery against committed plans.
* Product Quality & Reliability: Validation pass rates, field failures, defect recurrence, and endurance performance.
* Engineering Excellence: Design-review compliance, documentation quality, requirements traceability, and engineering-change closure.
* Production Readiness: Handover completeness, production rework, and manufacturing-related engineering issues.
* Innovation & Technology Roadmap: Roadmap achievement, technology maturity, platform reuse, and meaningful IP development.
* Customer Responsiveness: Technical issue resolution, trial readiness, and estimation accuracy.
* People Leadership: Retention of key talent, leadership development, succession planning, and team effectiveness.
* Cost & Resource Management: Budget adherence, resource utilization, prototyping costs, and development efficiency.
* Risk Management: Early identification, mitigation, and closure of critical technical and program risks.

**Candidate Requirements**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Robotics, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related engineering discipline.
* A postgraduate qualification in engineering, technology management, or business is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in engineering, R&D, or complex product development.
* At least 5 years in a senior R&D or engineering leadership role, managing multidisciplinary teams and complex technology programs.
* Proven experience taking integrated hardware-software products from concept and prototyping through validation, industrialization, and field deployment.
* Experience in robotics, autonomous systems, marine technology, defence, aerospace, industrial electronics, embedded systems, or similar deep-tech environments is strongly preferred.
* Exposure to high-reliability, mission-critical, government, or defence customer requirements is an advantage.

**Technical & Functional Skills**

* Strong understanding of systems engineering and multidisciplinary product architecture.
* Expertise in new product development (NPD), stage-gate processes, requirements management, and verification and validation.
* Experience in engineering program management, estimation, resource planning, and risk mitigation.
* Familiarity with design reviews, configuration management, engineering change control, and technical documentation.
* Knowledge of reliability engineering, FMEA, root-cause analysis, and structured problem-solving techniques.
* Understanding of design for manufacturing, assembly, serviceability, and production handover.
* Experience in technology evaluation, vendor management, and make-versus-buy decisions.
* Awareness of IP protection, product compliance, cybersecurity considerations, and component lifecycle management.
* Ability to translate customer requirements into feasible technical solutions and credible delivery commitments.

**Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic Thinking: Develops long-term technology and product strategies aligned with business priorities.
* Execution Excellence: Converts complex objectives into clear milestones, ownership, and measurable outcomes.
* Technical Judgment: Makes sound engineering decisions across multiple disciplines and evaluates trade-offs effectively.
* People Leadership: Develops future leaders, sets clear standards, and builds a culture of accountability.
* Stakeholder Management: Resolves cross-functional conflicts and aligns engineering, commercial, and operational priorities.
* Communication: Explains complex technical matters clearly to leadership, customers, and engineering teams.
* Decision-Making: Makes timely, evidence-based decisions and adapts when new information becomes available.
* Innovation & Learning: Encourages experimentation while maintaining engineering rigor and product quality.
* Integrity & Transparency: Communicates risks and delays early and maintains credibility around commitments.
* Composure Under Pressure: Provides direction during customer escalations, failed trials, and competing delivery priorities.

**First 180-Day Expectations**

* Assess the existing R&D organization, active programs, technical debt, capability gaps, and delivery risks.
* Establish a consolidated R&D portfolio with clear priorities, ownership, milestones, and escalation mechanisms.
* Strengthen product development processes, design reviews, documentation, configuration control, validation, and production handover.
* Develop an agreed technology roadmap and capacity plan in alignment with senior leadership, Sales, and Operations.
* Review the organization structure, leadership responsibilities, succession priorities, and critical hiring requirements.
* Identify recurring field and production issues and implement measurable corrective actions.
* Establish a predictable weekly and monthly R&D governance and reporting cadence.
* Improve engineering ownership, cross-functional collaboration, delivery predictability, and closure discipline.

**Definition of Success**
Success in this role means building a technically strong and operationally dependable R&D organization with a clear technology roadmap, reliable product releases, disciplined engineering processes, effective production handovers, and strong cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
The Head of R&D will be expected to develop engineering leaders, institutionalize technical knowledge, improve product reliability, and position R&D as a scalable driver of innovation and business growth.
  
  
**Role Expectations**
This is a strategic and execution-oriented engineering leadership position. It is not limited to research, individual technical contribution, or project coordination.
  
  
The successful candidate must be comfortable owning business outcomes, making cross-functional decisions, balancing immediate delivery requirements with long-term product maturity, and building an R&D function that can scale with the organization.

**Founding**
**Lead Developer**

As the Kochi team grows, you will help hire, onboard, and lead the developers who join you, and establish the engineering standards the team works to.

This is a genuine founding role. Your leadership scope will grow with the team, with a clear path to
**Engineering Manager as the Kochi team scales.**

As the company expands into the United States, the Kochi team will provide overnight turnaround for US clients, with issues raised during the US business day addressed while those clients sleep. You will help shape how this support model operates.

Core hours are
**8:00 AM to 5:00 PM IST**
, overlapping with the Sydney afternoon, with a paid, rostered on-call arrangement for urgent US client issues

**Major Accountabilities**

**Founding Team Leadership**

* Act as technical lead for the Kochi team from day one, setting local engineering practices, tooling, and ways of working.
* Help hire and onboard future Kochi developers, including shaping roles, interviewing candidates, and conducting technical assessments.
* Lead and mentor developers as the team grows, reviewing their work and raising engineering standards.
* Build a strong working rhythm between Kochi and Sydney through clear written updates, demonstrations, and shared planning.

**Platform Delivery & Ownership**

* Build deep knowledge across the front end, back end, data, and deployment pipeline.
* Deliver roadmap features in collaboration with the Head of AI and Engineering and the Product team, from design through to tested release.
* Deploy, troubleshoot, and recover the platform independently, ensuring no critical component depends on a single person.
* Maintain runbooks and architecture documentation to ensure platform knowledge is shared across the team.

**Client Requests & Issue Resolution**

* Own the triage and resolution of client requests and bugs in accordance with agreed service levels.
* Identify the root causes of production issues and deliver tested fixes that prevent recurring defects.
* Deliver client-requested enhancements in collaboration with the Product team, keeping clients informed throughout the process.

**US Expansion Support**

* Provide overnight turnaround for US client issues, with rostered on-call coverage for urgent escalations.
* Support US client onboarding and the engineering work required for US hosting, data residency, and compliance.
* Feed recurring US client issues back to Product and Engineering to help shape the roadmap.

**Engineering Quality & Secure Delivery**

* Apply established engineering standards for code review, testing, and release management to every change.
* Embed secure coding practices across access control, secrets management, and third-party dependencies.
* Work within an agent-driven engineering model, reviewing and hardening AI-generated code.
* Follow client data-handling and access requirements, including restrictions on where client data can be accessed from.

**Outcomes and Measures**

* By day 60, independently deploy, troubleshoot, and roll back the platform.
* By day 90, ensure every critical platform component has runbooks and architecture documentation, with at least two people capable of supporting it.
* Resolve client requests and bugs within agreed service levels while reducing the backlog.
* Reduce recurring defects, production incidents, and rollbacks with each release.
* Provide US clients with overnight turnaround on reported issues and a consistent onboarding experience.
* As the team grows, ensure new Kochi developers become productive within 60 days and work to the same standards as the wider engineering team.

**Professional Skills, Qualifications and Experience**

* 7+ years of software development experience, including 2+ years as a technical lead on a production SaaS platform.
* Experience mentoring developers, ideally including hiring and building an engineering team.
* Strong hands-on skills in TypeScript/JavaScript, Angular front-end development, and back-end API development.
* Deep relational database experience with PostgreSQL or SQL Server, including performance tuning.
* Practical cloud experience with Azure or AWS, along with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, and Docker.
* Proven production support experience, including debugging complex issues in multi-tenant SaaS environments.
* Knowledge of secure coding practices, including the OWASP Top 10. Exposure to ISO 27001, NIST CSF, or SOC 2 is an advantage.
* AI-native developer who uses AI coding tools daily and rigorously reviews generated code.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to work directly with Australian and US clients and colleagues.
* Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

**Personal Attributes & Interpersonal Skills**

* **Builder at heart:**
  Comfortable creating structure and processes where none exist yet.
* **Clear communicator:**
  Proactively keeps the Sydney team informed of progress, risks, and blockers without being asked.
* **Calm problem solver:**
  Approaches complex issues methodically and remains composed when clients are waiting for a fix.
* **Strong sense of ownership:**
  Follows every issue through to resolution.
* **Customer-minded:**
  Treats each client request as an opportunity to build trust.
* **Disciplined documenter:**
  Shares knowledge freely rather than keeping it to themselves.
* **Collaborative mentor:**
  Helps improve the skills and performance of the developers around them.

**How You Will Lead**

* **Set the standard:**
  Model the engineering practices you expect from the team.
* **Hire well:**
  Raise the bar with every person who joins the Kochi team.
* **Communicate early:**
  Surface progress, risks, and blockers before anyone has to ask.
* **Develop people:**
  Provide clear feedback and help each developer grow.
* **Own the outcome:**
  Combine accountability, pace, and high standards.

**Our Values**

* **Secure First:**
  Security is at the forefront of our decision-making.
* **Fail Fast:**
  Try new approaches, but change course quickly when necessary.
* **Customer-Driven:**
  Listen to our customers and act on their feedback.
* **Elegant Simplicity:**
  Less is more.
* **Stronger Together:**
  We are individually brilliant, but even better together.

All employees are responsible for their own health, safety, and wellbeing, as well as that of their colleagues, and for protecting company and client information.

* Comply with applicable local workplace health and safety laws and company policies.
* Maintain a safe and ergonomic working environment, including when working from home.

* Report any hazards, injuries, or security incidents to your manager promptly.
* Complete pre-employment background screening and ongoing security awareness training.

title: Hardware Engineer – Embedded Systems & PCB Design (UAV / Aerospace)
description:
Hardware Engineer – Embedded Systems & PCB Design (UAV / Aerospace)

**Company:**
Canary Aerospace Pvt. Ltd. | Part of Canary Digital Group

**Location:**
Kerala Technology Innovation Zone, Kerala Startup Mission, Kalamassery, Kerala – 683503

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time | On-Site

**Experience:**
2–8 Years

**Industry:**
Aerospace | UAV | Embedded Systems | Electronics Engineering

About Canary Aerospace

**Canary Aerospace Pvt. Ltd.**
, part of the
**Canary Digital Group**
, is an emerging Indian aerospace technology company focused on the design, development and manufacturing of advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), autonomous aerial platforms and next-generation aerospace technologies.

Our vision is to develop indigenous aerospace systems by integrating advanced electronics, embedded computing, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, autonomous navigation and precision engineering.

We are actively developing multicopter and fixed-wing VTOL platforms, proprietary flight-control electronics, ground control systems, communication solutions and autonomous UAV infrastructure.

As we expand our in-house engineering and R&D capabilities, we are seeking a passionate and technically accomplished
**Hardware Engineer – Embedded Systems & PCB Design**
to join our aerospace development team in Kalamassery, Kerala.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Hardware Engineer who can take complete ownership of electronic hardware development — from requirements and circuit design to PCB layout, prototyping, board bring-up, debugging, validation and production readiness.

The selected candidate will play a key role in developing indigenous electronic systems for UAV platforms, including flight-control boards, power distribution systems, sensor interfaces, communication electronics and intelligent payload systems.

**This is not merely a PCB layout position.**
You will be expected to understand the complete hardware–software interface, troubleshoot real-world engineering challenges and work closely with embedded firmware, avionics, mechanical and autonomous systems teams.

Your designs will become part of actual UAV platforms undergoing integration, ground testing and flight validation.

Key Responsibilities1. Electronic Hardware & PCB Design

* Design and develop multi-layer PCBs for UAV and aerospace applications.
* Own the complete PCB development lifecycle, including schematic capture, component selection, PCB layout, design verification and manufacturing release.
* Develop flight-control boards, power distribution boards, Electronic Speed Controller (ESC) interfaces, telemetry boards, sensor interfaces and payload electronics.
* Perform Design for Manufacturing (DFM) reviews and coordinate with PCB fabrication and assembly vendors.
* Prepare Bills of Materials (BOM), fabrication files, assembly documentation and engineering change records.

2. Embedded Systems & Hardware Integration

* Integrate microcontrollers and embedded computing platforms, including STM32, ESP32, NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi Compute Modules and similar systems.
* Work closely with firmware engineers on hardware bring-up, embedded C/C++ development and peripheral driver debugging.
* Design and validate interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, USB and Ethernet.
* Integrate navigation and environmental sensors, communication modules and mission payloads.
* Troubleshoot hardware–firmware interaction issues through systematic testing and debugging.

3. Power Electronics & Battery Systems

* Design power distribution and regulation circuits for UAV applications.
* Develop and validate buck converters, boost converters, LDO regulators and protection circuits.
* Support high-current battery-powered systems, including 12S–14S lithium-ion battery configurations.
* Implement current and voltage sensing, power monitoring, protection and redundancy mechanisms.
* Contribute to battery management, charging electronics and hot-swap power architectures.

4. Hardware Testing, Debugging & Validation

* Perform PCB bring-up, functional verification and fault diagnosis.
* Use oscilloscopes, logic analysers, programmable power supplies, multimeters and electronic loads.
* Carry out soldering, rework and troubleshooting of complex electronic assemblies, including fine-pitch and QFN components.
* Analyse signal integrity, power integrity, grounding and noise-related issues.
* Support EMI/EMC, vibration, thermal and environmental testing relevant to UAV applications.
* Participate in ground integration and flight-test validation activities.

5. Aerospace Electronics & Autonomous Systems

* Contribute to the development of proprietary autopilot and flight-control electronics.
* Support integration of IMU, GNSS/RTK, magnetometer, barometer, airspeed, voltage and current sensors.
* Develop electronic interfaces for telemetry, communications, propulsion and autonomous payloads.
* Support autonomous UAV docking infrastructure, including charging systems, battery-swapping electronics, safety interlocks and station-control boards.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure reliable system-level integration.

6. Engineering Documentation & Product Development

* Maintain schematics, PCB design files, wiring diagrams, interface control documents and test reports.
* Document hardware revisions, validation results, technical specifications and design decisions.
* Support the complete engineering lifecycle from concept development and prototyping to testing, qualification and manufacturing.
* Identify design improvements to enhance reliability, performance, manufacturability and cost efficiency.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* **2–8 years of relevant hands-on experience**
  in electronic hardware design, embedded systems or PCB development.
* Proven experience designing PCBs using Altium Designer, KiCad, OrCAD or equivalent EDA tools.
* Strong knowledge of analog and digital electronics, circuit design and electronic components.
* Practical understanding of power supply design, signal integrity, grounding and protection circuits.
* Working proficiency in Embedded C/C++ for hardware bring-up, debugging and peripheral interfacing.
* Experience with microcontrollers, communication protocols and embedded peripheral integration.
* Hands-on familiarity with oscilloscopes, logic analysers, power supplies and other electronic laboratory equipment.
* Ability to troubleshoot and rework assembled PCBs.
* Experience integrating sensors such as IMUs, GNSS, barometers and current/voltage monitoring devices.
* Ability to independently take a PCB design from schematic to a functioning, tested hardware prototype.

**Education:**
An engineering degree or diploma is welcome; however, relevant practical experience, demonstrated engineering capability and a strong technical portfolio will carry greater weight than academic background. Self-taught engineers with proven expertise are also encouraged to apply.

Preferred Skills – Added Advantage

* Experience with UAV flight-control systems, autopilot electronics or drone hardware.
* Familiarity with PX4, ArduPilot, Pixhawk hardware architecture, MAVLink or DroneCAN/UAVCAN.
* Experience with radio-frequency systems, telemetry, antenna integration, LTE/5G modules or satellite communication interfaces.
* Knowledge of functional safety, redundant system architecture or aerospace assurance practices such as DO-178C/DO-254.
* Experience with high-voltage UAV propulsion electronics, including battery configurations above 12S.
* Exposure to FPGA development or high-speed digital circuit design.
* Previous hardware engineering experience in UAV, aerospace, automotive, space or defence applications.
* Personal engineering projects involving drones, robotics, embedded electronics or autonomous systems.

What You Will Work On

You will contribute to the development of challenging and innovative aerospace technologies, including:

* **Indigenous UAV Flight-Control Electronics:**
  Proprietary autopilot hardware, navigation sensor interfaces and flight-control boards.
* **Power Management & Propulsion Electronics:**
  UAV power distribution, monitoring, protection and battery integration.
* **Advanced Embedded Computing:**
  Electronics supporting autonomous navigation, onboard AI processing and intelligent camera payloads.
* **Autonomous UAV Docking Systems:**
  Charging electronics, battery-swapping mechanisms, control interfaces and safety systems.
* **Next-Generation UAV Platforms:**
  Electronic hardware for multicopter and fixed-wing VTOL aircraft.

Why Join Canary Aerospace?

**Build Real Aerospace Technology**

Work on electronic systems that will be manufactured, integrated and tested on actual UAV platforms.

**End-to-End Engineering Ownership**

Take responsibility for complete hardware development, from schematics and PCB design through prototype validation.

**Indigenous Technology Development**

Contribute directly to the development of proprietary Indian aerospace and embedded technologies.

**Multidisciplinary Innovation**

Collaborate with teams working in aerospace engineering, AI, Computer Vision, avionics, autonomous systems and advanced manufacturing.

**Hands-On R&D Environment**

Work in a focused, engineering-driven environment with direct access to hardware prototyping and testing.

**Professional Growth**

Be part of a growing aerospace technology company with opportunities to contribute to increasingly advanced platforms and engineering programmes.

How to Apply

We invite passionate electronics and embedded systems engineers who enjoy designing, building, debugging and validating real-world hardware.

Please submit your
**updated CV along with a technical portfolio**
showcasing relevant projects.

Your portfolio may include:

* PCB schematics, layouts or photographs of developed boards.
* Embedded hardware or firmware projects.
* Prototype development, testing or debugging demonstrations.
* Engineering reports, photographs, videos or other evidence of working hardware.

Please briefly explain your individual technical contribution to the projects submitted.

**Apply through LinkedIn Jobs.**

Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a practical technical assessment relevant to the role.

**The Opportunity**
This role offers the opportunity to work within EY’s Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group, supporting leading global financial institutions in identifying, measuring, and managing risk including trading book market risk & counterparty credit risk, banking book credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory requirements. As part of the Quantitative Trading Book (QTB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk, treasury, and front to back-office functions. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk and valuation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision making for clients with capital markets activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and high impact capital markets engagements across global banks, broker dealers, asset managers, and insurance institutions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and industry knowledge of financial products
* Lead components of large-scale client engagements and/or smaller client engagements while consistently delivering quality client services
* Understand market trends and demands in the financial services sector and issues faced by clients by staying abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business
* Manage risk, and effectively communicate with key stakeholders regarding status, issues and key priorities to achieve expected outcomes.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of statistical and numerical techniques (e.g., Monte Carlo, finite difference methods)
* Knowledge of derivative pricing concepts across asset classes (rates, equities, credit, FX, commodities)
* Solid grounding in mathematical foundations including stochastic calculus, differential and integral calculus, probability, linear algebra
* Understanding of optimization techniques (e.g., gradient‑based methods) relevant to calibration, risk analytics, and numerical model implementation.
* Experience in model development, validation, monitoring, and audit procedures (stress testing, back testing, benchmarking) of trading book models.
* Strong coding skills in advanced Python / C++ and basic SQL
* Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in risk management, model validation, and quantitative workflow automation.
* Excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem solving skills.

**Ideally, You Will Also Have**

* Exposure to market risk and counterparty credit risk methodologies (VaR, ES, SVaR, CVA, PFE) and time series techniques (e.g. GARCH).
* Hands on experience with pricing model development/validation (e.g., HW1F/2F, HJM, LMM, SABR, Heston, Dupire), volatility calibration, curve bootstrapping.
* Experience with risk/pricing systems such as Murex, Calypso, Numerix, Bloomberg, Calypso, SunGard Adaptiv, RiskMetrics, etc.

**What We Look For**

* Undergraduate or graduate degree in quantitative disciplines (Comp. Finance, Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics, Physics) or PhD in quantitative topics
* Regulatory knowledge in FRTB Basel, CCAR
* Professional certifications (CQF, FRM, PRM, RAI are a plus)
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and support engagements with global financial institutions
* Willingness to travel based on client needs.

description:
**Who We Are**
We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.
  
  
We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.
  
  
Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.
  
  
**Why Worldwide**
We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!
  
  
\*SUMMARY: To co-ordinate and perform processes associated with the configuration, maintenance and validation of databases and database systems and associated applications. \*
  
  
**Responsibilities**
\_Tasks may include but are not limited to:\_
  
  
To liaise with relevant staff to determine the allocation of tasks, to establish timelines, to report progress and any issues outstanding.
  
  
To assist in training and mentoring Clinical Database Programmers in the configuration of databases and development, testing and running of SAS programs.
  
  
To assist in training and mentoring Data Management staff in the specification of databases and SAS programs.
  
  
To review specifications for the set-up and modification of project specific data entry software (including edit check specifications).
  
  
Review validation plan for edit check and reconciliation check specifications.
  
  
Develop, test and run SAS programs for clinical data management. This includes programs for data validation and reconciliation checks, data listings and data transfers.
  
  
To configure database/eDC software (both internal and 3rd party) for the use of DM, sponsor and sites.
  
  
To perform testing of databases and related applications according to IT and Data Management departmental SOPs, both for initial set-up and maintenance.
  
  
To run database upload programs and to process any error reports.
  
  
To liaise with 3rd party vendors to resolve issues, implement changes to software.
  
  
To liaise with Sponsors or their designates on matters associated with the transfer of electronic data to or from the company, as defined by the Director, Data Management.
  
  
To support Data Management in the production and maintenance of system procedures and documentation in accordance with applicable SOPs.
  
  
Assist with Quality Assurance and Audit requirements.
  
  
Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive.
  
  
\*OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES: \*
  
  
Be able to demonstrate good written and verbal communication skills.
  
  
Be able to demonstrate a methodical and logical approach to problem solving and the ability to learn new tasks quickly.
  
  
Be able to work with close attention to detail.
  
  
Be questioning about the validity of data being entered/extracted.
  
  
Be hardworking and efficient.
  
  
Possess good team working skills.
  
  
Key competencies in customer focus, delivering on commitments, building strong relationships, communicating and influencing, and embracing innovation and change.
  
  
The job holder must be computer literate and numerate with a willingness to adapt to various computer systems.
  
  
**Requirements**
Be educated to degree level or relevant experience
  
  
At least 5 years experience of Data Management Systems and Software
  
  
An understanding of CDISC SDTM standards
  
  
Experience of SAS programming language
  
  
Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently.
  
  
The company reserves the right to amend this job description in consultation with the employee to reflect changes in its organisational structure or to the job itself in line with emerging business needs
  
  
We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

title: Platform Infrastructure DevSecOps Developer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**I&O Platform Infrastructure AI-Native DevSecOps Developer**
**The opportunity**
In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for an innovative AI-Native DevSecOps Developer to rapidly design, build and ship custom software products that automate, orchestrate and modernize EY's infrastructure platform engineering capabilities. This is not a traditional software engineering role — it is a product builder position for someone who uses AI as their primary development accelerator and who thrives on shipping working software quickly.
  
  
The successful candidate will lead the end-to-end delivery of AI-native internal products — self-service infrastructure portals, workflow orchestration engines, policy-as-code enforcement systems and operational automation platforms — built on modern cloud-native stacks including Kubernetes, Temporal, Terraform and Angular. They will have sufficient infrastructure awareness to understand the operational context of what they are building, and will work closely with I&O engineering teams to translate complex infrastructure workflows into elegant, automated, AI-augmented software solutions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
The I&O Platform Infrastructure AI-Native DevSecOps Developer designs and delivers bespoke internal software products that eliminate manual infrastructure workflows, accelerate provisioning and give engineers and stakeholders real-time, self-service operational visibility. Drawing on AI coding tools as a core development accelerant, this professional dramatically compresses delivery timelines — prototyping, iterating and shipping production-grade software at a pace that traditional development workflows cannot match.
  
  
The role spans the full software development lifecycle — from requirements and architecture through build, test, security hardening, deployment and ongoing improvement — with a security-first mindset embedded at every stage. The developer will own the product delivery end-to-end, partnering with I&O platform engineers, architects and service management stakeholders to ensure what is built reflects the real operational needs of the infrastructure estate and is designed to scale across EY's global data center footprint.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Demonstrated ability to build and ship production-grade software rapidly using AI development tools as a primary delivery accelerant (exclusionary).
* Deep, active use of AI coding assistants throughout the development lifecycle, including:

+ GitHub Copilot or equivalent AI pair-programming tools
+ ChatGPT, Claude or similar LLMs for architecture design, code generation and review
+ AI-assisted test generation, security scanning and code refactoring
+ Prompt engineering for development workflow automation

* Strong full-stack development capability across front-end and back-end disciplines:

+ Angular (v14+) for self-service portal and operational UI development
+ Python or Go for back-end services, APIs and automation engines
+ REST and GraphQL API design and implementation

* Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration platforms, particularly Temporal.io.
* Strong Kubernetes engineering skills — deployment, Helm charts, operators, RBAC and namespace management.
* Infrastructure-as-Code authoring using Terraform and Ansible for provisioning automation.
* Strong DevSecOps pipeline development — CI/CD design, security gate integration and automated deployment:

+ GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps pipelines
+ SAST/DAST tooling integration (Snyk, SonarQube, OWASP ZAP or equivalent)
+ Container image scanning and policy enforcement (Trivy, Cosign, OPA/Gatekeeper)

* Policy-as-Code implementation using Open Policy Agent (OPA) or equivalent.
* Experience building AI-native product features, including:

+ LLM integration via API (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic or equivalent)
+ Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns for operational knowledge bases
+ AI-driven workflow decision making and self-healing automation
+ Copilot / chat interface integration into operational tooling

* Sufficient infrastructure platform knowledge to design software that reflects real-world operational constraints:

+ Virtualization and hyperconverged infrastructure concepts (Nutanix, Hyper-V, VMware)
+ Windows Server and Linux operating system fundamentals
+ Networking concepts — VLANs, DNS, IP management, load balancing
+ Storage and compute provisioning workflows
+ ServiceNow ITSM integration patterns

* Strong software product ownership mindset — able to take a problem statement from whiteboard to production with minimal hand-holding.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to demo working software and articulate product decisions to both technical and executive audiences.
* Strong working knowledge of Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.

**To qualify for the role, you must have experience with**

* Full-stack software product development and delivery — 5–7 years.
* AI-assisted software development as an active daily workflow — 2+ years.
* Angular front-end application development (v14+) — 3–5 years.
* Python or Go back-end service development — 5+ years.
* Kubernetes cluster management and application deployment — 3–5 years.
* Terraform and Ansible Infrastructure-as-Code authoring — 3–5 years.
* Temporal.io or equivalent workflow orchestration platform (Argo, Conductor or equivalent).
* CI/CD pipeline development with integrated security gates — 3–5 years.
* LLM API integration for production AI-native product features.
* Open Policy Agent (OPA) or equivalent policy-as-code enforcement.
* REST API design, development and documentation.
* Container build, scanning and secure image management (Docker, Podman).
* Git-based source control and pull-request-driven development workflows (GitHub, Azure DevOps).
* SAST/DAST security tooling integration in CI pipelines.
* ITSM platform integration — ServiceNow API or equivalent.
* Agile sprint-based delivery with regular demo and release cadences.
* Infrastructure provisioning workflow automation (VM builds, network configuration, DNS/IP management).
* Helm chart authoring for Kubernetes application packaging and deployment.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Microsoft Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204) or equivalent cloud certification (desired).
* Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) or CKA certification (better to have).
* HashiCorp Terraform Associate certification (desired).
* ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
* Experience building on or integrating with Nutanix platform APIs (NCM, Prism, Calm).
* Experience with Temporal Cloud or self-hosted Temporal cluster operations.
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio or Azure AI Studio for enterprise AI product development.
* Familiarity with GitOps patterns using ArgoCD or Flux for continuous deployment.
* Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source infrastructure automation projects.

**What We Look For**
A builder — someone who moves fast, thinks in systems and ships working software that solves real infrastructure problems. We are looking for an individual who genuinely uses AI as a development superpower, who understands enough about infrastructure to design software that works in the real world, and who takes pride in owning a product end-to-end from first commit to production. * Apply AI/ML techniques to support access risk analysis, anomaly detection, role mining, certification insights, and privileged access intelligence.

* Design AI-enabled governance capabilities across SailPoint, Saviynt, access reviews, lifecycle management, provisioning, SOD, and compliance reporting.

**Required Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Python, PowerShell, APIs, automation scripts, data pipelines, and cloud-native integration patterns.

title: TC-CS-IAM-SailPoint ISC-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Cyber Security-IAM- SailPoint ISC Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* 3-7 years of experience in designing and deploying ISC-based Identity Governance and Administration solutions.
* Configure and manage SailPoint ISC tenant, including deployment of Virtual Appliances for secure connectivity between cloud and on-premises environments
* Integrate of different auth sources and create identity profiles with transforms.
* Manage identity lifecycle through Joiner-Mover-Leaver processes.
* Develop workflows and custom forms for access requests and access review modules.
* Write and maintain Cloud Rules using Java/BeanShell for complex attribute transformations.
* Build and configure connectors for systems like Active Directory, Azure AD, Workday, Web Services, and JDBC.
* Work with SailPoint REST APIs for bulk operations, custom reporting, and external integrations (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow).
* Demonstrate strong understanding of JSON, XML, REST/SOAP, and SCIM protocols.
* Stay updated on latest ISC modules and functionalities such as AI and CIEM.
* Sailpoint engineer certification is preferred

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you
