title: Senior OT & IT Data Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior OT/IT Data Specialist will support the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform. This role bridges industrial automation, OT/IT networking, industrial data engineering, and modern software platforms. The successful candidate will support integration of shop-floor equipment and OT systems with edge, enterprise IT, and cloud services while ensuring industrial data is secure, reliable, well-governed, and fit for downstream applications.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on technical role that combines architecture support, technical delivery, platform troubleshooting, vendor coordination, stakeholder collaboration, data governance, and operational support across manufacturing locations. The role will work closely with architects, engineers, lifecycle teams, system integrators, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable smart factory solutions and support future digital manufacturing initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Participate in site-level architecture design activities across manufacturing locations and support implementation of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform.
* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Data Backbone infrastructure, including Kubernetes/OpenShift-based edge deployments.
* Integrate industrial equipment, PLCs, and OT systems using industrial protocols such as Siemens S7, OPC UA, MQTT, and similar connectivity technologies.
* Troubleshoot OT/IT networking issues including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and edge-to-cloud connectivity.
* Build, support, and maintain industrial data pipelines, messaging solutions, and integration architectures using technologies such as Litmus, MQTT, and OPC UA.
* Develop and maintain industrial data models to contextualize machine, asset, and time-series data for downstream applications and analytics.
* Perform data validation and troubleshooting across the complete machine-to-cloud data flow, including equipment, network, edge platform, data pipeline, and database/cloud environments to ensure data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
* Support technical acceptance testing of vendor solutions following deployment and contribute to Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) activities.
* Support IT/OT risk assessments related to the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform and connected manufacturing systems.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of data governance standards, documentation, tag naming conventions, and tag enablement processes.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation including system designs, technical procedures, configuration guides, governance documentation, and operational support materials.
* Collaborate closely with architects, lifecycle teams, software developers, data engineers, system integrators, vendors, and manufacturing stakeholders to support successful project delivery.
* Support system enhancements, upgrades, troubleshooting activities, and continuous improvement initiatives for industrial data platforms and connected systems.
* Transfer technical knowledge to lifecycle teams, contractors, vendors, developers, and support personnel to ensure sustainable long-term platform ownership.
* Take ownership of assigned technical activities and proactively drive issues to resolution while effectively communicating progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, quality standards, cybersecurity requirements, and engineering governance practices.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Data Science, Automation, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline is preferred.
* Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience supporting one or more of the following areas:
* OT/IT convergence
* Industrial automation
* IIoT and Smart Factory platforms
* Industrial data engineering
* Industrial IT
* Platform engineering
* Systems engineering
* Strong experience with industrial protocols and connectivity technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, Siemens S7, or equivalent industrial communication protocols.
* Strong understanding of OT/IT networking concepts, including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and secure connectivity.
* Experience designing, implementing, or supporting industrial data pipelines, messaging platforms, and integration architectures.
* Experience working with industrial Historians, time-series databases, or similar industrial data platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, or other containerized deployment technologies.
* Experience with Litmus or equivalent industrial edge platforms is preferred.
* Experience with AVEVA Historian, QuestDB, PI System, Ignition Historian, or equivalent Historian/time-series database platforms is desirable.
* Experience with tag enablement, Historian/SCADA tag scaling, and configuration activities is preferred.
* Experience with Unified Namespace (UNS) architectures and industrial data contextualization is desirable.
* Experience working in multi-site manufacturing, industrial, process industry, energy, oil and gas, utilities, or brownfield operational environments is advantageous.
* Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity practices and standards such as IEC 62443.
* Experience supporting production platforms, operational support teams, and lifecycle management activities.
* Experience collaborating with external technology vendors, system integrators, and third-party service providers.
* Ability to develop and maintain solutions using Python, Go, TypeScript, Node-RED, or similar technologies.
* Experience with modern software development and operational practices including SLAs, change management, incident management, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across OT, IT, engineering, and business teams.
* Demonstrates ownership by taking responsibility for issues, following through on actions, and driving tasks to completion.
* Shows initiative, adaptability, and a proactive attitude while working across organizational and geographical boundaries.
* Produces accurate, maintainable, and well-documented technical solutions while maintaining high standards of quality and reliability.
* Comfortable working in a global environment with stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones.
* Willingness to travel internationally, including visits to Denmark and manufacturing sites as required.

title: Lead Salesforce
description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
**About the Role**
We are seeking an experienced and highly capable
**Salesforce Lead**
to drive the technical delivery of our next-generation
**Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform**
powered by Salesforce, Agentforce, AI, Data Cloud, and MuleSoft.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical leadership role for professionals who can
**lead development teams, guide solution design, mentor developers and senior developers, and closely partner with architects to deliver scalable enterprise solutions**
. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce platform expertise with strong people leadership, delivery ownership, and architectural thinking.
  
  
As a Salesforce Lead, you will be responsible for translating business and platform strategy into high-quality technical solutions while ensuring adherence to architecture, governance, security, and engineering best practices. You will lead cross-functional teams building intelligent service management experiences across Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Agentforce, Enterprise Service Management (ESM), ITSM, CMDB, IT Asset Management, and enterprise integrations.
  
  
This role offers an opportunity to play a key leadership position in shaping the future of AI-powered service management and conversational enterprise platforms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead a team of Salesforce Developers and Senior Salesforce Developers across multiple workstreams.
* Provide technical leadership throughout the full software development lifecycle, from solution design to production deployment.
* Partner closely with Salesforce Architects to translate architectural vision into scalable and maintainable technical solutions.
* Own technical delivery, ensuring solutions meet business, security, scalability, and performance requirements.
* Drive estimation, sprint planning, technical task allocation, and delivery execution.
* Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and architecture compliance reviews.
* Establish and enforce Salesforce development standards, coding conventions, CI/CD processes, and governance frameworks.

**Solution Design & Development**

* Lead the design and development of Salesforce solutions supporting the organization's Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform.
* Design scalable solutions leveraging Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Platform, and Agentforce capabilities.
* Build intelligent service experiences utilizing Agentforce, AI-driven workflows, conversational experiences, and autonomous service capabilities.
* Design and develop complex solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, Platform Events, Integration Patterns, and Salesforce APIs.
* Guide implementation of enterprise service management processes including:

+ Incident Management
+ Service Request Management
+ Change Management
+ Problem Management
+ Knowledge Management
+ Employee Support Services
+ CMDB Management
+ IT Asset Management
+ Service Catalog Management

**Integration & Enterprise Architecture**

* Lead enterprise integration initiatives using MuleSoft and API-led connectivity patterns.
* Design reusable integration frameworks connecting Salesforce with ITSM, ERP, HR, Monitoring, Collaboration, Identity, and Business Systems.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects and integration teams to ensure platform interoperability and data consistency.
* Drive API governance, performance optimization, security controls, and integration best practices.

**Team Leadership & Mentoring**

* Mentor Salesforce Developers and Senior Developers through coaching, design guidance, and hands-on technical support.
* Support career development and capability building within the Salesforce team.
* Identify skill gaps and define technical learning and certification roadmaps.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Act as the primary technical escalation point for complex solution and production challenges.

**AI & Platform Innovation**

* Champion adoption of Agentforce, Generative AI, Data Cloud, and emerging Salesforce innovations.
* Guide implementation of conversational AI, agentic workflows, intelligent automation, and self-service experiences.
* Evaluate new platform capabilities and recommend innovative solutions that improve service delivery and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to strategic platform roadmaps and technology decision-making.

**Required Qualifications**
**Must Have**

* 7 to 10 years of Salesforce platform experience with at least 2-3 years in a technical lead role.
* Strong hands-on expertise across:

+ Service Cloud
+ Sales Cloud
+ Experience Cloud
+ Salesforce Platform

* Deep technical expertise in:

+ Apex
+ Lightning Web Components (LWC)
+ Salesforce Flows
+ SOQL/SOSL
+ Platform Events
+ Integration Patterns
+ REST/SOAP APIs
+ Salesforce Security Model

* Strong experience with large-scale Salesforce implementations and enterprise delivery programs.
* Experience leading and mentoring development teams.
* Experience working alongside solution architects and enterprise architects.
* Proven ability to drive technical decision-making and delivery governance.
* Strong understanding of:

+ Data Architecture
+ Security & Sharing Models
+ DevOps & CI/CD
+ Release Management
+ Application Lifecycle Management

* Experience in Agile, Scrum, and DevOps-driven environments.
* Strong stakeholder communication and leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing Enterprise Service Management (ESM) and IT Service Management (ITSM) solutions.
* Experience with:

+ CMDB
+ IT Asset Management (ITAM)
+ Service Catalog
+ Enterprise Operations Management

* Hands-on experience with MuleSoft and API Management.
* Experience working in global delivery models.
* Salesforce Platform Developer I & II Certifications.
* Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect Certification.
* Scrum Master, SAFe, or Agile certifications.

**Added Advantage**

* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce.
* Experience building Conversational AI and autonomous service experiences.
* Exposure to Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts.
* Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud.
* Experience delivering Digital Transformation and Enterprise Automation initiatives.
* Knowledge of Service Operations, ITIL, or Enterprise Service Management frameworks.

**What We Are Looking For**
We are seeking professionals who:
  
  

* Think like technical leaders while remaining hands-on contributors.
* Can successfully lead teams while maintaining a strong engineering mindset.
* Are comfortable partnering with architects and influencing platform strategy.

title: AI Architect
description:
We are seeking an experienced AI Architect to design and guide the implementation of secure, scalable, and production-ready artificial intelligence solutions. This role will establish enterprise AI architecture, lead technical design decisions, and support the delivery of machine learning and generative AI capabilities across cloud and enterprise environments.

The ideal candidate combines strong architecture and software engineering experience with hands-on knowledge of large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, AI governance, cloud platforms, and enterprise application integration.

Key Responsibilities

AI Solution Architecture and Delivery

* Design end-to-end architectures for machine learning and generative AI solutions.
* Lead the architecture and implementation of solutions involving large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, intelligent document processing, automation, and predictive analytics.
* Define reusable architectural patterns, reference architectures, and technical standards for enterprise AI.
* Guide engineering teams in developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining AI solutions that support clinical, operational, and administrative use cases.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend appropriate platforms, models, tools, and implementation approaches.

Enterprise AI Infrastructure

* Design and optimize enterprise AI infrastructure across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Define architectural requirements for scalability, availability, security, reliability, and performance.
* Establish deployment, monitoring, and operational standards for AI workloads.
* Support platform health, system performance, capacity planning, and infrastructure readiness.
* Collaborate with cloud, infrastructure, security, data, and application teams to ensure architectural alignment.

Enterprise Systems Integration

* Design integration patterns connecting AI capabilities with enterprise applications, data platforms, healthcare systems, and business workflows.
* Define secure interfaces, APIs, data pipelines, and orchestration patterns for AI-enabled solutions.
* Partner with business and technical teams to understand system dependencies and integration requirements.
* Support implementation teams in resolving complex integration and architectural challenges.

AI Governance, Security, and Responsible AI

* Establish AI quality, safety, security, privacy, and governance standards.
* Define evaluation frameworks, testing approaches, validation methods, and monitoring requirements for AI solutions.
* Ensure solutions comply with organizational policies, regulatory requirements, and responsible AI principles.
* Identify and mitigate technical, operational, security, privacy, and model-related risks.
* Incorporate human oversight, traceability, and appropriate controls into AI solution designs.

Technical Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership

* Serve as a technical subject matter expert supporting AI strategy, adoption, and solution implementation.
* Translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for business and executive stakeholders.
* Lead architectural reviews and provide technical direction to engineering and delivery teams.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and provide implementation guidance.
* Present findings, recommendations, architectural decisions, and solution options to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Collaborate across clinical, operational, technical, security, compliance, and executive teams.

Required Qualifications

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Equivalent combinations of education, relevant certifications, and professional experience may be considered.

Experience

* Minimum of
  **5 years of professional experience**
  in AI, machine learning, software engineering, data engineering, solution architecture, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale AI or machine learning solutions.
* Experience developing solutions using Python and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience with cloud-based AI services and infrastructure, including Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services, and Databricks.
* Experience with generative AI technologies, large language models, prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented generation.
* Experience integrating AI capabilities with enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, and business workflows.
* Experience establishing technical standards, reusable architecture patterns, or reference architectures.
* Experience moving AI solutions from proof of concept into secure and supportable production environments.

Required Knowledge and Skills

* Advanced knowledge of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and generative AI technologies.
* Strong understanding of large language models, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, and retrieval-augmented generation.
* Knowledge of AI solution architecture, system integration, application architecture, and data architecture.
* Understanding of cloud architecture, containerization, distributed systems, APIs, and modern deployment practices.
* Familiarity with structured and unstructured data management and analytics platforms, such as Databricks or comparable technologies.
* Knowledge of AI governance, model evaluation, validation methodologies, privacy, security, risk management, and responsible AI.
* Ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs and recommend solutions based on business, architectural, security, and operational requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical decision-making skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across clinical, operational, technical, security, compliance, and executive teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a related field.
* Relevant cloud, architecture, data, security, or AI certifications.
* Experience working in healthcare or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience with healthcare data, clinical systems, or electronic health record environments.
* Experience implementing AI governance, model monitoring, or AI risk-management frameworks.
* Experience guiding multidisciplinary teams through AI solution design and production implementation

Perform review and provide guidance on the development of the clinical database specification, data transfer agreement/specification, specification of tables, figures and listings (TFL) shells. title: Senior Agentic AI Developer
description:
**Company Description**

Passio Communications is a 360-degree integrated marketing agency where passion, creativity, and innovation drive branding and digital experiences. The team brings together digital marketing specialists, branding experts, and web design professionals to help clients grow and transform their online presence. With strong capabilities in custom web design, UI/UX, packaging, and logo design, Passio serves clients across Dubai, the UAE, and Kerala. The agency focuses on delivering impactful, tailored solutions that align with each brand’s unique needs and aspirations. Joining Passio means contributing to bold, high-impact work that turns brand stories into measurable success.

We are looking for a Senior Agentic AI Developer to join our team and lead the charge in bringing complex multi-agent architectures to life.

**What You Will Do**

* **End-to-End Delivery:**
  Design, build, and ship robust multi-agent systems from the initial client brief straight through to production using frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, n8n, or similar.
* **Knowledge Architecture:**
  Architect and construct scalable RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines and rich knowledge bases utilizing modern vector databases.
* **System Integration:**
  Connect intelligent agents to enterprise ecosystems—including CRMs, ad platforms, and complex APIs—leveraging advanced tool calling and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* **Quality & Observability:**
  Set up rigorous guardrails, continuous evaluations, and robust observability pipelines using platforms like Langfuse, LangSmith, or equivalent.
* **Leadership:**
  Lead by example through comprehensive code and prompt reviews, and actively mentor junior developers to elevate the team's capabilities.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  2–3 years of professional experience in software engineering and AI development.
* **Core Stack:**
  Strong, production-level proficiency in
  **Python**
  or
  **TypeScript**
  .
* **AI Expertise:**
  Deep, hands-on experience working directly with modern LLM APIs.
* **Track Record:**
  You must have successfully shipped at least one AI agent to real users in a production environment

 Strapi and Headless CMS Development

 • Connect Strapi backends to front\-end applications using REST or GraphQL

 • Develop responsive, reusable UI components using React.js (or similar frameworks such as Next.js, Vue.js, or Angular)
 



 • Build small to mid\-sized web applications, including dashboards, forms, portals, and internal tools
 



 • Integrate third\-party APIs and services
 



 • Manage application state and data fetching efficiently
 



 • Ensure cross\-browser compatibility and accessibility standards
 



  





 General Engineering
 



  





 • Write clean, well\-documented, testable code
 



 • Use Git for version control and take part in code reviews
 



 • Debug and resolve technical issues quickly
 



 • Estimate tasks, communicate progress, and flag risks early
 



 • Contribute ideas to improve our processes, tools, and code quality.
 



  





 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
 



  





 • \[2\-4]\+ years of professional web development experience
 



 • Strong proficiency in PHP and WordPress development (themes, plugins, hooks, REST API)
 



 • Hands\-on experience with Strapi or another headless CMS
 



 • Solid experience with JavaScript (ES6\+) and React.js or a comparable framework
 



 • Good understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design (Flexbox, Grid, Tailwind, or SASS)
 



 • Experience working with REST APIs; GraphQL is a plus
 



 • Working knowledge of databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB
 



 • Familiarity with Git and collaborative workflows
 



 • Ability to work from design files (Figma, Adobe XD) and deliver pixel\-accurate results
 



 • Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
 



 • Good written and verbal communication in English
 



  





 NICE TO HAVE
 



  





 • Experience with Next.js, Node.js, or Express
 



 • TypeScript
 



 • Experience with hosting and deployment (AWS, DigitalOcean, Vercel, Netlify, cPanel, Docker)
 



 • CI/CD pipelines
 



 • WooCommerce or e\-commerce development
 



 • Knowledge of SEO best practices and performance tools (Lighthouse, GTmetrix)
 



 • Website security best practices
 



 • Experience with automated testing (Jest, Cypress, etc.)
 



  





 WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU
 



  





 • Ownership: You take responsibility for your work from requirements to delivery.
 



 • Reliability: You meet deadlines and communicate early if something changes.
 



 • Quality: You care about performance, security, and maintainability, not just “it works.”
 



 • Collaboration: You work well with designers, PMs, and other developers, and accept feedback openly.

title: Software Development Manager 1
description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.
   

  

 At SOTI, we are committed to delivering best in class mobile and IoT device management solutions. We are looking for out of the box thinkers that appreciate the art of creating great software.
   

  

 To us, being visionary is more important than doing things the way they have always been done.
   

  

**What We ’re Looking For?**
 Our people are our most important resource. We are looking for a highly skilled Software Development Manager to become one of them, to make an impact and offer a unique value. If you are eager to prove your understanding of technical and managerial skills, your strong problem\-solving abilities in a fast\-paced environment and you are willing to learn then we want to hear from you.
   

  

**What is in it for you?**
*The People \-* 
 From our humble origins in our founder’s basement, to our industry leading position today, SOTI has worked hard to foster a company culture that we can all believe in. A culture that emphasizes personal growth, continuous innovation, and fun.
   

  

*The Growth \-* 
 Our environment fosters new ideas, fresh perspectives, and the ability to take them over the goal line. SOTI is a fast\-paced environment with a global reach that encourages you to make your mark and be part of something big!
   

  

*The Technology* 
 \- You will get the chance to work with leading edge technologies and take on complex and interesting projects, as part of highly collaborative and agile teams. You will work alongside SOTI’s partners which include leading tech giants that will keep you on the cusp of emerging technologies.
   

  

**What You ’ll Do?**
* Act as a technical lead/coach for a team that is researching and developing new solutions/technologies, by providing direction, encouragement, and technical expertise to the team
* Explore new technologies and assist team members to create solution concepts out of these technologies
* Implement efficient/creative principles to explore new solutions (ideation, design, prototyping, and testing)
* Manage implementation plans (schedules, team updates) for selected concepts and participate in their transitioning into future roadmaps
* Lead and participate in product design reviews and complex technical initiatives with Architecture, Research and Development, Emerging Technology, internal Product Development, and other stakeholders, as required (e.g. refactor, redesign, or upgrade product designs to meet customer and regulatory compliance requirement
* Interface with management to present new ideas and discuss their implementation (design, architecture, features, timelines)
* Provide the necessary direction, encouragement, and technical expertise to the team
* Facilitate the Agile process within the team
* Develops technical capabilities of team members through on the job and external training
* Constantly explores latest development tools and present them to the team
* Encourages “best\-practices” sharing through the participation and promotion of meetings, knowledge sharing tools and other initiative liaising


**Experience You ’ll Bring**
* A bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related discipline
* Over 14\+ years of experience in Software Development, Design and Testing with over 4 years in a leadership capacity
* Ability to effectively promote teamwork and collaboration
* Demonstrated problem solving skills applied to people and technology
* Strong understanding of software development practices \& best practices for the full software development life cycle
* Have product sense, deep understanding of the broader product vision and ability to plan \+ design various features in stages to reach the end goal in an evolutionary way is critical.
* Manage agile teams with a proven track record of building high performing teams.

External field/FDE patterns emphasize embedding closely with customers and iterating quickly based on feedback, which should be reflected in this role.

* Work with cross\-functional teams spanning cybersecurity, privacy, AI engineering, cloud, and client stakeholders to deliver secure and workable outcomes.


**Required Qualifications**

* Practical familiarity with AI/ML concepts relevant to data protection, including machine learning, deep learning, NLP, RAG, AI\-assisted prioritization, and model risk scoring.

* Experience writing small scripts, automations, or integrations in Python.
* Familiarity with cloud\-native deployments on Azure, AWS, or GCP, and basic understanding of APIs and enterprise integrations. Comparable AI delivery roles frequently require these capabilities.


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of data protection, privacy, cloud, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the data protection practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.

* Experience integrating AI services into enterprise automation platforms (e.g., Power Platform, ServiceNow).
* Familiarity with Azure AI services and data platforms.


**Detailed Responsibilities:**
* Solution Development: Design, develop, and implement automation solutions using Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and ServiceNow. Create custom workflows, forms, and applications to automate business processes and enhance user experience.
* Integration Management: Integrate Microsoft and ServiceNow platforms with other enterprise applications using APIs, web services, and middleware. Ensure seamless data flow between systems and maintain data integrity across integrated applications.
* Testing and Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough testing of automation solutions to ensure functionality, performance, and compliance with business requirements. Implement best practices for code quality, documentation, and version control.
* Observability and Maintenance: Monitor the performance of automation solutions and troubleshoot issues as they arise. Perform regular maintenance and updates to ensure optimal functionality and security of automation applications.
* Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for automation solutions, including design specifications, user guides, and technical manuals. Document processes, workflows, and integration points for future reference and knowledge transfer.
* User Training and Support: Provide training and support to end\-users and team members on automation tools and processes.Develop training materials and conduct workshops to facilitate user adoption of automation solutions.
* Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including business analysts, project managers, and IT staff, to ensure alignment on automation initiatives. Engage with stakeholders to gather feedback and make necessary adjustments to automation solutions.
* Performance Metrics and Reporting: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of automation solutions. Generate reports and dashboards to communicate the impact of automation on business processes and operational efficiency.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on the latest trends and advancements in automation, AI, and relevant technologies.Identify areas for continuous improvement and propose enhancements to existing automation solutions.
* Governance and Compliance: Ensure that automation solutions adhere to organizational policies, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements. Participate in risk assessments and audits related to automation initiatives.
* Innovation and Research: Explore and evaluate new technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance automation capabilities. Conduct research on industry best practices and competitor strategies to inform decision\-making and innovation.
* Change Management: Analyze the impact of automation on organizational processes and culture, making recommendations for change management strategies. Assist in developing communication plans to inform stakeholders about automation initiatives and their benefits.


**Other Requirements:**

* Strong communication, stakeholder management and influence
* Strong leadership and conflict resolution capability
* Leading virtual teams


**Job Requirements:**

**Experience:**
* 10\+ years in a Global IT environment working with multiple disciplines to deliver projects in line with customer needs

* 3\+ Years in a global operations environment


**Certification Requirements:**

* Python Certification
* Azure AI Services
* Azure Data Services


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

title: GDS Cyber - AI Driven IAM - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-Cyber Security\- Senior AI Engineer – IAM \& Cybersecurity**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to support the design and delivery of AI\-led solutions across Identity and Access Management and Cybersecurity domains. This role will help shape how AI capabilities are applied to modern IAM challenges such as identity governance, access management, privileged access, directory services and non\-human identity security.
   

  

 As a senior profile, the candidate will work closely with IAM, Cyber, cloud and business stakeholders to understand client problems, identify practical AI opportunities and convert them into working solutions, prototypes and scalable delivery assets. The focus is not only on technology implementation, but also on improving identity risk visibility, access decisioning, governance efficiency and operational effectiveness.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should bring strong hands\-on engineering experience, curiosity to work in the IAM and Cyber domain, and the ability to apply AI, automation and analytics to solve real enterprise identity challenges. While the role requires practical exposure to AI and IAM technologies, the emphasis is on problem solving, consulting mindset, solution ownership and the ability to contribute to enterprise\-scale IAM transformation programs.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop and operationalize AI solutions for IAM and Cybersecurity use cases across SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, IGA, PAM, AD/Entra ID and NHI domains.
* Build hands\-on AI/ML capabilities using Python, PowerShell, LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, ADKs and AI orchestration engines.
* Develop agentic AI workflows, copilots and automation frameworks for access requests, certification campaigns, provisioning, privileged access, remediation and identity operations.
* Integrate AI solutions with SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure, AWS, Microsoft Graph API, SIEM/SOAR, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike and XDR platforms.
* Analyze identity, access, privilege, vault, directory, activity and security logs to identify risk patterns, anomalies, access recommendations, role mining opportunities and policy gaps.
* Support AI\-driven IAM governance including risk\-based authentication, risk\-based provisioning, access reviews, compliance checks, SOD, identity lifecycle orchestration and audit\-ready reporting.
* Apply ML, classification, optimization, time series analysis, pattern recognition, NLP, UEBA, anomaly detection and predictive risk scoring for identity and access intelligence.
* Work on Non\-Human Identity use cases including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API\-based identities, workload identities, agent identities, token misuse and agent overreach controls.
* Contribute to PAM analytics and automation across CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secret lifecycle management, session monitoring and vault log analytics.
* Create dashboards and insights using Power BI, Tableau and identity analytics views to explain access risk, compliance posture, user activity trends and remediation priorities.
* Collaborate with business, cyber and IAM stakeholders to convert problem statements into working prototypes, scalable solutions and executive\-ready recommendations.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**
**Required Skills**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in AI engineering, software development, data science, automation, cybersecurity analytics or IAM technology delivery.
* Practical experience building AI applications using LLM/SLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, agentic AI, AI agents, copilots and multi\-agent workflows.
* Strong programming and automation experience in Python, PowerShell, APIs, SQL basics and Microsoft Graph API; exposure to HTML, CSS and JavaScript is preferred.
* Hands\-on exposure to Azure AI, OpenAI, AWS, Python\-based AI/ML frameworks, ML models, classification, optimization, NLP, pattern recognition, time series analysis and anomaly detection.
* Working knowledge of IAM concepts including SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, SAML, OAuth, OIDC with PKCE, authentication, authorization, federation, certificate management and key management.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Entra Connect, Cloud Sync, Directory Services, DNS, Global Catalog, GPO, OU, Domains/Forests, FSMO roles and Sites and Services.
* Experience or strong exposure to IGA platforms and concepts such as SailPoint, Saviynt, identity lifecycle, access reviews, certification campaigns, role mining, SOD, access risk and policy compliance.
* Experience or strong exposure to PAM concepts and tools including CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secrets, session monitoring and vault logs.
* Understanding of NHI and AI identity security including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API\-based identities, workload identities, agent identities and token controls.
* Experience with security monitoring or analytics platforms such as SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, XDR and Identity Protection.
* Strong consulting mindset with the ability to communicate AI, IAM and Cybersecurity topics clearly to technical teams and leadership stakeholders.


**Nice to have**
* Experience identifying AI use cases for IAM transformation, identity analytics, access recommendations, privileged access recommendations, NHI governance and automated remediation.
* Experience with data pipelines, identity and privilege analytics pipelines, model monitoring, observability, MLOps and scalable deployment of enterprise AI solutions.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, dashboards and data storytelling for access risk, compliance posture and identity operations.
* Exposure to SOX, GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001, CISSP, CISM, SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Azure AI or Google ML certifications is preferred.
* Prior experience in a consulting, professional services or large enterprise environment is a plus.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture** 
 : In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits** 
 : Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**The Role** 




 As a Platform Engineer in the Data \& Analytics team, you’ll sit at the vital intersection between software engineering and infrastructure. Your mission is to ensurethat the systemswe build are not only functional, but also resilient, observable, performant, and production ready.
 



 You’ll work closely with engineers, architects, and the central infrastructure team to design and support the environments, tooling, and operational practicesthat power our data platform.From CI/CD pipelines to database performance tuning, observability, and scaling strategy — you’ll be the expert who helps us build mechanical sympathy between our code and the systems it runs on.
 



 This is a hands\-on, enablingrole ideal for someone who loves helpingteams ship great software safelyand reliably.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own and evolve the CI/CD pipelines for the Data Platform, supporting fast, safe, and repeatable deployments.
* Enhance observability across services, pipelines, and data flows, supporting logs, metrics, tracing, and alerts.
* Monitor and optimize databaseperformance, availability, and access patterns.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure teamsto ensure HA, disaster recovery, and scaling strategies are in place and well understood.
* Partner with engineers to define best practices for environment management, secrets, configuration, and infrastructure\-as\-code.
* Support the team in diagnosing and resolving production issues and in building systemsthat are easier to debug and maintain.
* Identify and reduce operational friction, creating tools or automations where needed to improve reliability and developer velocity.



  





  





 Essential Criteria
 



  




* Strong experience working with CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and application performance tooling.
* Practical knowledge of observability stacks— including metrics,logs, dashboards, and alerting.
* Hands\-on experience with databases(e.g. PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or cloud\-native DBs), including monitoring and tuning.
* Familiarity with cloud environments (preferably AWS), containerization, and infrastructure\-as\-code tools (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation).
* A collaborative mindset, able to work across engineering and infrastructure teamsto solve shared problems.
* Passion for enabling others,improving developer experience, and building reliablesystems.



  





  





 Desirable Criteria
 


* Experience supporting data pipelines, analytics platforms, or distributed systems at scale.
* Familiarity with data management frameworks (e.g. AWS Glue, Temporal) and performance profiling in data\-intensive environments.
* Exposure to monitoring tools such as CloudWatch, Grafana,Datadog, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry.
* Understanding of security best practices relatedto data platforms, secrets management, and access control.
* Knowledge of container orchestration and serverless deployment patterns (e.g. ECS, Fargate, Lambda).



  





  





 What We Offer
 


* A unique opportunity to shape the operational backboneof our company’s data platform.
* A collaborative engineering culturewhere operational excellence is valued and supported.
* The freedom to improvehow things are built, deployed,and run with real impact.
* A close partnership with experienced engineersand infrastructure specialists.
* A modern, cloud\-native stackand a platform that’s scalingrapidly.

title: CDP Engineer
description:
**Responsibilities**
* Configure and maintain CDP data models, audience/segment definitions, and identity resolution.
* Build and maintain CDP integrations with Databricks/Delta Lake (zero\-copy access patterns).
* Design and maintain event streaming integration using AWS MSK (Kafka), including external publishing.
* Build, configure, and maintain destination connectors to Adobe Campaign Classic (email), Airship (push), and Infobip (SMS).
* Build and support journeys/orchestration logic, including governance and suppression across overlapping member experiences.
* Support integration work for experimentation/personalization layers (e.g., Optimizely, Bloomreach) consuming CDP\-supplied segmentation.
* Build ingestion pipelines for engagement feedback loops (delivery/engagement events flowing back into Databricks).
* Scope and deliver platform enhancements as new use cases, channels, audiences, or business requirements emerge.
* Partner with product/marketing stakeholders to translate business requirements into CDP configuration and logic.
* Triage, troubleshoot, and resolve platform issues raised by business/marketing stakeholders (e.g., segment/audience errors, sync failures, journey/campaign delivery issues, data discrepancies).
* Perform root\-cause analysis on production issues and implement fixes or workarounds.
* Monitor platform health (sync jobs, journey runs, data freshness, audience counts) and proactively flag/address problems.
* Maintain documentation for platform configuration, data flows, API contracts, and known issues/resolutions.
* Participate in vendor working sessions to define technical requirements and surface product gaps.


**Required Skills**
* 5\+ years working directly in/on a CDP or similar MarTech data platform (configuration, activation, and support)
* Hands\-on experience with audience/segment building, identity resolution, and journey/orchestration tooling
* Strong Databricks and Delta Lake experience (Unity Catalog, data\-sharing connectivity)
* AWS experience, particularly MSK/Kafka.
* REST API integration experience with marketing execution platforms (ESP, push, SMS providers)
* Adobe Campaign Classic experience \- hands\-on with workflows, campaign/journey setup, and API\-based integration
* API\-first, composable architecture / connector\-based integration experience
* Experience implementing/maintaining a CDP Web SDK or similar client\-side event tracking SDK (JavaScript) for behavioral/event data capture
* Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills; comfortable being a hands\-on point of contact for business\-reported issues
* Strong technical skills


 Support CDP (Customer Data Platform) as part of the Personalization Program covering platform configuration, audience/segmentation build, journey/orchestration support, integrations, enhancements, and ongoing production support. This is a broad CDP role, not limited to integration work, it includes building and maintaining segments, campaigns/journeys, governance and suppression logic, and troubleshooting issues across the platform end\-to\-end.

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis

 As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.

* Must have experience in SailPoint IIQ \& IDN architecture, design, development, configuration, testing, integration, and deployment.
* Must have experience in source/ Identity profile configuration, transform/rule development, workflow configuration, JML process and certification, Password sync.
* Must have experience in onboarding AD, JDBC and web service applications to IIQ/IDN
* Must have experience in deployment of virtual appliance, understanding different VA architecture, deploy rules in cloud/VA, High availability/DR configuration
* Configuration and deployment of IQService in cloud and on\-prem environments
* Must have hands on experience in configuring quick link, custom work flow, reports, developing service account management modules, integration with other tools like Service Now, CyberArk etc and plugin development
* IIQ Installation, set up and initial configuration/ upgradation to different versions of IIQ, Standard service build set up and configuration
* Professional IT certifications are a plus.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: O9 Engineer
description:
Experience \- 5 plus years
   

  

 We are hiring an O9 Solutions Engineer to support and evolve the O9 platform for one of the largest retailers in the United States. O9 is the system of record for demand forecasting, supply planning, and allocation decisions across our brands, regions, and channels. This role owns the day\-to\-day health of the platform — triaging and resolving incidents, maintaining data integrity between O9 and upstream/downstream systems such as Oracle EBS, and partnering with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and Merchandising teams to keep the platform reliable, accurate, and easy to use across a global user base (US, UK, EMEA, and APAC).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Serve as a primary point of support for O9 Supply Planning and Demand Planning modules, triaging incidents end\-to\-end from intake through root\-cause and resolution.
* Investigate and resolve data integrity issues between O9 and connected systems (Oracle EBS, RMA/returns feeds, buy\-plan and sourcing extracts), including mismatched quantities, missing style\-colors, and forecast data not flowing between planning modules.
* Diagnose and fix planning logic issues — unmet demand, incorrect season codes, planned orders not grouping correctly, buy dates shifting unexpectedly, and similar planning\-engine anomalies.
* Manage user access and provisioning (new hires, role changes, regional access, ownership transfers) and drive toward self\-service or bulk\-provisioning workflows to reduce manual ticket volume.
* Own incident and backlog hygiene: track SLAs, prioritize aging tickets, and ensure nothing sits unresolved for months without visibility to stakeholders.
* Partner with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and regional business teams (US, UK, China, Japan) to translate business\-reported issues into technical root causes.
* Build and maintain runbooks, root\-cause documentation, and knowledge base articles so common issues can be resolved consistently — not just by institutional memory.
* Support configuration changes, workflow updates, and enhancements within O9 as the retailer's planning processes evolve (new brands, new seasons, new regions).
* Participate in O9 platform upgrades, testing cycles, and post\-implementation review (PIR) processes for major changes.
* Escalate to and collaborate with O9 Solutions' vendor support team on platform\-level defects that require vendor engineering involvement.
* Skillset
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience supporting or implementing O9\.
* Solid understanding of retail supply chain planning concepts: demand forecasting, supply/buy planning, allocation, assortment, and season/style\-color management.
* Experience integrating planning systems with ERP platforms, ideally Oracle EBS, including familiarity with common data reconciliation issues between planning and execution systems.
* Strong troubleshooting skills — comfortable reading data flows end\-to\-end to isolate whether an issue originates in source data, integration, or planning logic.
* Experience with incident management tools (ServiceNow or similar) and a track record of managing ticket queues, SLAs, and prioritization in a production support environment.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data investigation and validation.
* Excellent written communication skills — you'll be documenting root causes and explaining technical issues to non\-technical business stakeholders across time zones.
* Comfortable working with global, cross\-regional teams (US, EMEA, APAC) and adjusting communication style accordingly.

title: Platform Infrastructure Application Performance Management and Logging - ELK - SME
description:

**Job Description**
 I\&O Platform Infrastructure Application Performance Management and Logging (ELK) SME
   

  

 Assistant Director \| Enterprise Technology
   

  

**The opportunity**
 In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology, we are looking for a proven Application Performance Management (APM) and Logging SME to support and evolve EY's monitoring and observability platforms globally. The role will provide engineering leadership, operational support, automation and lifecycle management for the firm's APM tooling and the ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) stack. The successful candidate will work with cutting\-edge observability technologies, driving platform maturity, operational excellence and engineering innovation across EY's global infrastructure estate.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 The I\&O Platform Infrastructure APM and Logging SME provides technical leadership and engineering of complex nature for the firm's application performance monitoring and centralized logging platforms. This professional applies knowledge of APM solutions, the ELK stack, log management, metrics pipelines and distributed tracing to support enterprise\-scale workloads and enable rapid incident response.
   

  

 The role requires deep knowledge of the firm's infrastructure monitoring landscape to implement platform enhancements, lifecycle management activities, onboarding programs, security initiatives and operational improvements. The SME will serve as the subject matter authority for APM and logging platforms, partnering with application teams, infrastructure engineers and security stakeholders across global locations to ensure observability coverage, data quality and platform reliability.
   

  

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong experience designing, deploying and administering ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) at enterprise scale.
* Deep knowledge of APM tooling (e.g., Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Elastic APM, New Relic or equivalent).
* Experience architecting centralized logging solutions and log aggregation pipelines.
* Strong understanding of metrics, traces and logs as the three pillars of observability.
* Experience with Elasticsearch cluster management, index lifecycle management (ILM) and snapshot/restore.
* Knowledge of Logstash pipeline development and Beats (Filebeat, Metricbeat, Winlogbeat) deployment.
* Experience building Kibana dashboards, visualizations and alerting rules.
* Experience with log parsing, field extraction, grok patterns and data enrichment.
* Knowledge of distributed tracing frameworks and instrumentation approaches.
* Strong scripting and automation skills, including:
+ Python
+ PowerShell
+ Bash / Shell scripting

* Experience integrating monitoring platforms with ITSM tooling (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Ability to produce high\-quality technical documentation, runbooks and operational procedures.
* Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
* Ability to work effectively with clients, management and global engineering teams across multiple time zones.


**To qualify for the role, you must have experience with**
* ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) — enterprise\-scale deployment and administration. 7\+ years.
* APM platform engineering and administration (Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Elastic APM or equivalent). 7\+ years.
* Centralized logging architecture design and operations. 7\+ years.
* Elasticsearch cluster management, performance tuning and capacity planning. 7\+ years.
* Logstash pipeline development and Beats agent fleet management. 5–7 years.
* Kibana dashboard and visualization development. 5–7 years.
* Index lifecycle management (ILM), hot\-warm\-cold architecture and data tiering. 5–7 years.
* Log parsing, grok pattern development and field enrichment. 5–7 years.
* Metrics collection frameworks (Prometheus, InfluxDB, StatsD or equivalent).
* Distributed tracing — implementation, instrumentation and analysis.
* Alert management and notification workflows across monitoring platforms.
* SIEM integration and security event log forwarding.
* TLS/SSL configuration and security hardening of ELK components.
* Role\-based access control (RBAC) within Elasticsearch and Kibana.
* Containerized deployment of ELK components (Docker, Kubernetes or OpenShift).
* CI/CD pipeline integration for monitoring\-as\-code and configuration management.
* Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity planning for monitoring platforms.
* Performance troubleshooting of high\-ingestion Elasticsearch clusters (50 GB\+/day).
* Onboarding application and infrastructure teams onto APM and logging platforms.
* Windows and Linux systems administration supporting ELK infrastructure.


**Ideally, you'll also have**
* Elastic Certified Engineer or Elastic Certified Analyst certification (desired).
* Dynatrace Associate or Professional certification (desired).
* Microsoft Azure Administrator or equivalent cloud certification (desired).
* ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
* Experience with OpenTelemetry (OTel) standards and collector configuration.
* Experience with Elastic Cloud or Elastic Cloud on Kubernetes (ECK).
* Familiarity with cloud\-native logging solutions (Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, GCP Cloud Logging).
* Experience operating in a managed service or large enterprise shared services environment.


**What We Look For**
 An experienced and technically deep observability engineer and leader to help build, operate and modernize EY's APM and centralized logging platforms. We are looking for an individual with proven expertise in ELK stack engineering, strong APM platform knowledge, a passion for operational excellence and automation, and the ability to serve as the technical authority for monitoring and observability across EY's global infrastructure estate.

* 5\-7 years of experience in implementation, support and upgrade projects in SAP TM.
* Must have good functional and business knowledge, worked in multiple E2E implementations, integration, testing and application support in S/4HANA embedded TM and SAP TM (latest versions)

* Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills for co\-ordinating across teams
* Should be able to lead workshop or working sessions with business

* Advanced knowledge of Charge calculation, Freight Agreement Management, Rate tables and Transportation cost allocation

* Data migration methodologies using DRF, LSMW, SAP Data Services, or Migration Cockpit; system landscape design (Development, Quality, Production)
* Understanding of SAP TM on HANA optimization, performance tuning, and analytics capabilities
* Expertise in implementation planning, fit\-gap analysis, SAP TM system configuration E2E, testing, rollout and post\-implementation support


**Industry Knowledge**
* Expertise in logistics and supply chain operations across multiple transportation modes (road, rail, ocean, air, intermodal)
* Knowledge of carrier management practices, freight procurement, contract negotiations, and service level agreements
* Familiarity with industry best practices, benchmarks, and emerging trends (sustainability, real\-time visibility, autonomous transportation)

* Project governance frameworks, steering committee management, and escalation resolution
* Risk management, issue resolution, and proactive communication to ensure on\-time delivery

* Desired to have SAP certification on SAP TM.
* Having experience of working in integration area of SAP TM and other areas.
* Minimum of 5\-7 years of experience in SAP TM.
